info.name: ION Buyer App (BAP)
info.description:
Beckn v2.0.0 requests the ION reference BAP sends through its ONIX adapter (bapTxnCaller).

Set bap_id, bpp_id and networkId (and the URIs if yours differ) before running. bap_adapter_url defaults to http://localhost:8081/bap/caller.

Request bodies follow the schema the ONIX adapters validate against: Beckn core https://schema.ion.id/release1/schema/vendored/beckn/api/v2.0.0/beckn.yaml (plus ion-additional.yaml for /reconcile and /on_reconcile), and every object carrying @context/@type against that pack's attributes.yaml (IONTradeOffer, IONTradeConsideration, IONTradeResource, IONTradeCommitment, IONTradePerformance, IONTradeProvider, IONTradeContract, IONTradeSettlement, IONSettlementReconciliation, beckn Consumer).

All requests describe one worked order: 2 x Kemeja Batik Tulis Parang at Rp 225.000 (pre-tax), PPN 12% on a taxable base of 11/12 (Rp 24.750 per unit), Rp 10.000 delivery, total Rp 509.500. The seller's buyer finder fee is 3% of ITEM_TOTAL = Rp 13.500 commission, so the BPP's net payable is Rp 496.000.

request.description: Free-text search. The BAP sends only intent.textSearch (search text, plus the provider name when the buyer filters by one). No bppId/bppUri: discover goes to the CDS (mock-cds in local routing), which answers on_discover to the BAP receiver.

Buyer picks resources from an on_discover catalog. One commitment per selected item: status DRAFT, the resource with its quantity, the offer as published (considerations + offerAttributes.policies), and commitmentAttributes (IONTradeCommitment) with lineId/resourceId/quantity. Performance f1 carries placeholder delivery details (no PII at select). The buyer participant is a beckn Consumer with role "buyer".

The BPP ignores any terms the BAP sends and uses the ones stored for the offer.

The on_select contract plus the buyer's details: Consumer.person (name/email/telephone) and performance deliveryDetails. The BAP declares the payment settlement: one IONSettlementReconciliation (method/paymentRail QRIS, collectedBy BAP, timing ON_ORDER, status PENDING) with its own settlementAccounts entry (holderRole BAP) and figures estimated on the quoted price (orderAmount, commission = buyerFinderFee.feeAmount, withholdingAmount 0, refundAmount 0, netPayable).

The on_init contract (with the contract id the BPP assigned) after payment. The settlement becomes status COMMITTED and its attributes status PAID with paidAt and gatewayRef; orderAmount is the amount paid.
